caption: 💌 Do not forget to SAVE for your next calm toddler snack 🍎 👩‍🍳 Share with a mama friend who loves real, simple food I used to dread snack time ... until I started making these soft apple peanut butter rolls 🍎 Simple, cozy, and toddler-approved 💛made with real food, not rules. Bake once, enjoy all week ☁️ Dough: 1 ½ cup (190 g) spelt flour 1 cup (240 g) plain yogurt 1 ½ tbsp (20 g) butter, soft ½ tsp baking powder ½ tsp cinnamon pinch of salt Filling: 1 apple, finely diced & softened 3–4 min 1 tbsp peanut butter 1 tbsp date syrup ½ tsp cinnamon Topping  Peanut butter 🥜  Greek yogurt  Bake: 180°C / 350°F for 20-25 min Storage: Fridge 5 days, freezer 1 month #healthysnacksideas #sugarfreesnacks #toddlerapproved #toddlersnacks
